Faith is of central importance to my family and I and we cherish the ability to worship as we please.

Today on #ReligiousFreedomDay and every day, we are grateful for Americans' right to exercise religious freedom in our Nation and recognize our responsibility to preserve it.

We owe a debt of gratitude to those who have put their lives on the line for our Nation.

Ohio @DAVHQ helps veterans file VA claims to access their pension, healthcare, & more.

Yesterday I met with them to discuss how Congress can ensure veterans receive the support they deserve!

Living in a rural area shouldn’t be a barrier to accessing health care.

I helped reintroduce the Rural Wellness Act with @RepNikkiB, @RepFinstad, & @RepDonDavis to increase access to behavioral telehealth & substance abuse treatment for rural Ohioans.

https://t.co/CHvH4Fciro

Mental Health Awareness Month is an opportunity to prioritize rest, connection, & the things that contribute to our overall wellness.

Thank you to each health care provider, counselor, friend, family member, & first responder who has lent a helping hand to assist someone during a time of need. You are irreplaceable cornerstones in our communities who help Ohioans live their lives to the fullest.

If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, call 988 to speak with a trained counselor now.

For decades, the Left has pushed a destructive agenda compromising the safety of American children, and radical medical associations have been part of that effort since the beginning.

Even after the Supreme Court’s recent rebuke, there was no pause in the ongoing betrayal of American children by our once-trusted medical associations. No longer should dangerous gender ideology be pushed on impressionable youth along with access to irreversible drugs and destructive surgeries in the name of “progress.” We must stand up for our children.

The Supreme Court took a strong first step to stop this madness and Congress should affirm their decision by passing laws further strengthening the Court’s position.

https://t.co/QxAZRhZtme

The One Big Beautiful Bill will expand access to childcare for hardworking American families and strengthen paid family & medical leave.

It will quadruple the maximum employer-provided childcare credit and deliver new relief for small businesses that provide childcare.

This is critical to supporting American families & working parents.

The One Big Beautiful Bill is chock-full of wins for Ohio farmers, ranchers, & producers. It:

- Expands crop insurance & improves risk management tools
- Boosts market access & reduces trade barriers for American agriculture products
- Protects family farms from excessive taxes by raising the Death Tax exemption
- Provides disaster relief

I’m proud to work with Republicans in Congress & President Trump to deliver the results our Ohio agriculture community needs!

It was my pleasure to tour the @Sofidelsharing plant in Circleville with Charity, Health & Safety Manager Randy Kuhner, & Facility Manager Brian Graves. The Circleville site is the largest plant worldwide, also known as a mega site. The 283-acre facility is home to over 580 Ohioans & is a third-generation family business. 

SOFIDEL is the 5th largest producer of paper in the world, producing a whopping 140,000 tons of toilet paper per year. The huge roll of toilet paper behind Charity & me stretches 40 miles in length! I’m honored to advocate for the needs of businesses like theirs in Congress that keep our local communities booming.

The team at @CincinnatiVamc is committed to providing our Nation’s Heroes with the high quality healthcare and support they deserve, employing more than 2,600 Ohioans and serving over 47,000 veterans. 

I met with Acting Medical Center Director Jim Hall and Acting Associate Director Benjamin Billon to hear about the services they provide to veterans in the Cincinnati area and see their facilities firsthand.

They shared how the center will be transitioning to the Federal Electronic Health Record system in the summer of 2026, their needs for infrastructure improvements, and their plan to have a new Community Based Outpatient Clinic in Union Township completed in the fall of 2026. I am a staunch supporter of our Nation’s veterans and am honored to continue advocating for their needs and for the needs of our local VA medical centers in Congress.

Next time you see a pharmaceutical advertisement, ask yourself: how much does this medication really cost?

Unless Congress passes my bill, you may never know.

https://t.co/lbL0WjA7pg

Love seeing the Trump Administration continuing to put patients first. 

Americans deserve transparency when it comes to direct-to-consumer drug advertising so they can make safe & informed decisions about their healthcare.  

Congress should take similar action by passing my bill, HR 3789, so prescription drug costs aren’t a secret. 

https://t.co/IE7FBtbRRs

The Working Families Tax Cut will lower taxes for hardworking Ohio families, make a historic investment in rural healthcare and small businesses, secure our borders, & protect critical programs for vulnerable Americans.

I was proud to support it and will continue advocating for the needs of Buckeye families in Congress.

How are @HouseGOP & President Trump Making Rural America Healthy Again?

By delivering $50 BILLION in funding to rural healthcare facilities through the Rural Health Transformation Program, passed in the Working Families Tax Cut.

https://t.co/cGtMgApClv

Yesterday I talked with @OhioEggFarmers & @CooperFarms_ about how avian influenza is impacting the poultry industry & what challenges they’re navigating with animal health.

Cooper Farms is a family-owned business in Northwest Ohio that raises turkeys, egg layers, & hogs. The doubled agriculture trade funding in the Working Families Tax Cut will help give businesses like theirs a helping hand.

Even though many agriculture wins were passed in this bill, I’m continuing to push for a Farm Bill 2.0 that further supports the needs of Ohio farmers, ranchers, & producers.

The Alliance for Pharmacy Compounding represents over 600 member pharmacies, ensuring the safety and accessibility of prescription medication in our communities.

This week, I talked with them about the importance of solving prescription drug shortages and ensuring patients have access to the medicines they need.

Thank you to Economic Development Director Chandler Grooms for assembling a fantastic group of business entrepreneurs, educators, representatives from @Atomic_CU, and the new Director of @AdenaHealth Medical Center, Andrew Bower, to have a robust discussion on business in southern Ohio.

It’s inspiring to hear about the projects already underway in the Village of Waverly that are improving lives across the entire village and Pike County. I look forward to working with these leaders and Waverly Mayor Rick Henderson to bolster opportunities in the area and help our local business community be successful.

Democrats want to take away health care for rural Americans.

Their version of a Continuing Resolution would STRIP the $50 billion in the Rural Health Transformation Program, the single largest investment in rural health through President Trump’s Working Families Tax Cuts. They are literally shutting down the government because they want to take money away from rural health care providers to give it to illegal aliens.

It’s clear who has rural Americans’ backs when it comes to health care.
Democrats shut down the government. One of their demands? The elimination of a $50 billion rural health care program.

Democrats: “We’re not giving free healthcare to illegal aliens.”

Their CR text: “Let’s reinstate the ALIEN MEDICAID ELIGIBILITY that the Working Families Tax Cut got rid of.” https://t.co/8v0dGBBaqH

Republicans: “Let's avoid a shutdown and extend funding for 7 weeks so we have more time to agree to year-long appropriations.”

Democrats: “We will shut the government down unless we get $1.5 TRILLION in new spending, repeal fraud-reduction measures, . . . and fund health care costs for illegal aliens.”

Democrats need to stop putting on a show for their far-left base and get serious about keeping the government funded for the American people.

Let's call it like it is: Democrats are shutting the government down because they are mad that Republicans got rid of $200 BILLION worth of benefits noncitizens were getting.

This is what they are upset about when they say “health care cuts!”

The Rural Health Transformation Program will address the health care workforce shortage in rural areas like southern Ohio and ensure sustainable access to care. 

While Democrats are demanding its repeal in exchange for reopening the government, I’m staunchly advocating for rural providers and patients. 

Read my Op Ed:

https://t.co/zqweasPr8I

It’s time to bridge the health care gap across rural America. 

I led a letter with my colleagues @Jim_Jordan, @Rep_Davidson, & @RepMichaelRulli urging @GovMikeDeWine to direct Rural Health Transformation dollars toward independent rural hospitals, rural Federally Qualified Health Centers, and creative solutions to address health care challenges in Ohio.

World Mental Health Day is a reminder to check in on our loved ones and know that it’s okay to reach out for support when we need it.

In southern Ohio, our family farming community works tirelessly day in and day out. They face long hours, geographic isolation, and limited access mental health care. It can be very stressful and often lonely work. I’ve got our farmers’ backs and will continue to advocate not only for their needs to succeed financially, but for their mental health needs as well.

If you need help, call or text the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline at 988 for free, confidential support.

Yesterday I was honored to join local leaders at a groundbreaking ceremony for the Mt. Orab Family Medicine Clinic at @southernstatecc.

It’s great to see health centers opening to serve southern Ohioans. I’ll continue advocating for the needs of patients and providers in our region!
